[b][u]_______________________________________[/u][/b]
[list] | For the last few weeks, the Federal Government has been quietly watching the surprising increase in births across the nation first starting out as an unusual but welcomed discovery within even the poorest regions of Ascoiya, before watching it slowly spread to even the more developed areas, as even Serceniza itself the capitol and that of Iyen the nation's Economic hub was not spared from the growth, like all things however panic began to spread with all of these births came new issues, and the nation's infrastructure was not prepared nor ready enough for another baby boom, however at the same time with the increased birth rate came new opportunities and thus began the nation's silent motions to increase public transportation, by now the Serceniza-Iyen Metropolitan line was completed yet there were still new opportunities for Ascoi and the rest of the island itself, afterall the blueprints were laid out and given to the provinces should they care enough to develop it.

And many did, the once blockaded alleyway was finally opened not only was it just a mere tunnel into the ground but an entire developed area, furbished with open squares and nearby buildings alike, as the sounds of an incoming train could be heard from beneath the ground the first of many electric metropolitan lines soon to come even as a voice began to blare over the Metro's announcement another voice came from a user's headphones although the radio signal was rather spotty underground than it was above, unfortunately for him he was now underneath a few thousand meters of water and even more so a few dozen meters if not more under the gulf's floor | [/list]

[spoiler= 376.82hz || Ch. 02 - The Official Ascoiyan National Broadcast | Tuesday 22nd June, 2027]

[list][list] [i]" Isdentai Zeten-ati Inaka, I am your host. Ciastil-Zeten-Janis reporting live from the newly built entrance of the Serceniza-Iyen Subway, with it being just slightly cloudy than usual yet still a fair and warm twelve-degrees Celsius, now onto the actual meat of today's story."

" As it would seem our government officials and the nation alike is seeing a rather dramatic birth rate, while previously the nation has hovered in or around some sixty-seven million citizens for once it seems that it maybe changing, either caused by the recent stability or heavy shift from low-paying wages into more heavier and apparently according to the academics more critical and skilled industries something seems to have changed and have gotten everyone into a new mood, some are calling this change overdue while others are still trying to get used to it, with hospitals alike being swarmed with the amount of new births, as here in Yatentia alone the provincial government has seen a rather dramatic increase from it's usual 1.2 percent birth rate to as high as nearly 30 percent if not more. "

" And it seems the story is similar across the nation, on other news the political leader of the Foreign Liberation Party and CEO of Astiveistan Group, Dara Zeniena-Uisa has been surprisingly arrested and held within custody of Serceniza Metropolitican police under charges of Corporate malpractice, Bribery and according to this list, Charges of Deliberate corruption, such charges even to the lookers around me have gotten us all within a state of shock, let alone with the recent declaration from the Ministry of Economy establishing the formal Central Bank of Ascoiya, and the Approval of a whole host of Ascoiyan-Authorized digital transaction services"

" And ontop of everything else it is reported that Numerous provinces seeing the rather surprisingly effective nature of the Serceniza-Iyen metro are attempting to do the same, sooner if not later I predict we might end up seeing a proper rejuvenated trainline and metros across the nation similar to the likes of that of the Second Republic, it may seem it is all I have for you listeners today, yet make no mistake things are changing for the better and please do take care to give enough care and space to our national medical worders"[/i] [/list][/list]
